n9d653b6973.headline: Dayforce Enters Definitive Agreement With Thoma Bravo
n9d653b6973.summary: Dayforce has entered a definitive agreement with Thoma Bravo to become a privately held company in an all-cash transaction. The deal would take the human capital management software provider off public markets.
n9d653b6973.why: Dayforce is a US-listed provider of cloud payroll and workforce software. Thoma Bravo is a private equity firm that specialises in buying and taking software companies private.

na5bb7fcba6.headline: New tax laws will boost citizen’s purchasing power, says Wale Edun as PepsiCo expands production line
na5bb7fcba6.summary: Finance Minister Wale Edun said new tax laws will boost the purchasing power of Nigerians. The comments came as PepsiCo expanded a production line in Nigeria.
na5bb7fcba6.why: Tax policy shapes household spending and corporate costs, which matter for consumer and fast-moving goods companies operating in Nigeria. PepsiCo is a global food and beverage group.

nb9fda5650d.headline: McCormick To Acquire Additional 25% Stake In McCormick De Mexico For $750 Mln
nb9fda5650d.summary: McCormick has signed a definitive agreement to buy an additional 25% stake in its joint venture McCormick de Mexico from Grupo Herdez for $750 million. The deal increases its control of the long-standing Mexican venture.
nb9fda5650d.why: McCormick is a US-listed spice and seasoning company, and the Mexican joint venture is one of its key international operations.

n4d9b09b755.headline: Nigeria: Anger over planned pay rise for political office-holders
n4d9b09b755.summary: Some stakeholders have asked Nigeria's Revenue Mobilisation, Allocation and Fiscal Commission to shelve plans to review political office-holders' salaries. The move comes amid hardship in the country.
n4d9b09b755.why: Public salary and fiscal allocation decisions affect government spending and the policy credibility that matters to investors in Nigeria.

nca79ce79b3.headline: Rupee falls 18 paise to close  at 87.25 against US dollar
nca79ce79b3.summary: The rupee pared early gains and closed 18 paise lower at 87.25 per US dollar on Thursday. Forex traders cited a strong American currency and a recovery in crude oil prices.
nca79ce79b3.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects India's import costs, including oil, and the returns foreign investors earn on Indian assets.

n2c1bc4b0f4.headline: Nigeria’s Forex Reserves Surge to $41 Billion, Highest in Nearly Four Years
n2c1bc4b0f4.summary: Nigeria's foreign exchange reserves rose from $39.54 billion on August 1 to $41.00 billion by August 19, with $1.46 billion added month-to-date.
n2c1bc4b0f4.why: Foreign exchange reserves help central banks defend the currency and meet external obligations, which matters for investors in Nigerian assets.

n8c0602e608.headline: Firms involved in alleged Sambu stock manipulation raided
n8c0602e608.summary: A special counsel team investigating suspicions involving former first lady Kim Keon Hee searched the headquarters of Well Biotec, a company affiliated with the probe.
n8c0602e608.why: Stock manipulation investigations affect investor confidence in listed companies and the enforcement credibility of Korea's capital markets.

nd2582e4353.headline: Rapid overhaul of Australia’s environment laws among flurry of pledges from productivity roundtable
nd2582e4353.summary: Australia's Treasurer announced consensus on reform directions including stronger environmental standards, changes to foreign investment rules and new guidelines for AI.
nd2582e4353.why: Productivity reforms, foreign investment rules and environmental approvals shape business costs and investment conditions in Australia.

n26d95a81e0.headline: Average five-year mortgage drops below 5% to lowest level in two years
n26d95a81e0.summary: The average five-year fixed mortgage rate is now 4.99%, dropping below 5% for the first time since 2023, according to BBC News. The rate has reached its lowest level in two years.
n26d95a81e0.why: Mortgage rates shape household borrowing costs and housing demand, and they track expectations for interest rates and lender funding costs in the UK.

n675beb3962.headline: PENGASSAN Renews Call for Divestment in Refineries, Pushes for Oil Sector Reforms
n675beb3962.summary: PENGASSAN President Festus Osifo renewed calls for divestment in refineries and oil sector reforms at the PEARLS 2025 energy and labour summit in Abuja.
n675beb3962.why: Nigeria's refinery and oil sector reforms affect fuel supply, government revenue and investment appetite for the country's energy industry.

n5cd48e5787.headline: The Athens stock exchange after the bailouts - How far has the Greek stock market advanced?
n5cd48e5787.summary: The Athens stock exchange has moved past investment difficulties after the bailouts and has again become a pole of attraction for foreign capital.
n5cd48e5787.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and its performance reflects investor confidence in the Greek economy.

n6ac2ffaa2e.headline: Adeleke Meets U.S. Political, Business Leaders in Atlanta, Declares Osun Open for Global Partnerships
n6ac2ffaa2e.summary: Osun State Governor Adeleke met US political and business leaders in Atlanta, according to a statement, as part of efforts to attract cross-border collaborations and economic development.
n6ac2ffaa2e.why: Subnational investment promotion in Nigeria can bring foreign partnerships and capital to states such as Osun.

n96ce7378f3.headline: Fiscal Policy Committee charts Malaysia’s sustainable economic path amid global shifts
n96ce7378f3.summary: Malaysia's Fiscal Policy Committee has set a 3.8% deficit target for 2025 and projects growth of up to 4.8%. Changes are being mapped ahead of Budget 2026.
n96ce7378f3.why: Fiscal deficit targets and growth forecasts guide government borrowing, bond issuance and investor expectations for Malaysia's economy.

ncc9e079fd4.headline: Stock markets extend winning run to 6th day;  Sensex climbs 143 points on buying in ICICI Bank, Reliance
ncc9e079fd4.summary: Indian stock markets extended their winning run to six sessions on Thursday. The 30-share BSE Sensex closed about 143 points higher, led by buying in ICICI Bank and Reliance Industries.
ncc9e079fd4.why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 large companies listed in Mumbai and is the main benchmark for Indian equities. ICICI Bank and Reliance are among its heaviest-weighted stocks.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: The Sensex closed higher for a sixth consecutive session, reflecting the day's gains in its constituents.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n93bbfcd817.headline: These Texas Filmmakers Have Helped Shape Hollywood
n93bbfcd817.summary: Rocket attacks in January to June 2025 damaged or destroyed 45,000 sq m of office space in Kyiv. A third of lease agreements relate to tenants moving out of damaged buildings, CBRE Ukraine reported.
n93bbfcd817.why: Commercial real estate tracks occupier demand and building supply, and war damage reduces available office stock. CBRE is a major global property services firm.

nde8e194d2d.headline: Euro zone business activity accelerates in August - PMI
nde8e194d2d.summary: Euro zone new orders rose for the first time since May 2024 in August, helping overall business activity expand at the fastest pace in 15 months. Exports remained weak, a survey said.
nde8e194d2d.why: The euro zone purchasing managers' index is a closely watched gauge of private-sector health across the currency bloc, shaping expectations for European Central Bank policy and regional growth.

n3940dcdadf.headline: Australian Government pushes EV road-user charge to top of tax reforms to-do list
n3940dcdadf.summary: The Australian government has put an electric vehicle road-user charge near the top of its tax reform list. Electric car drivers could soon pay more under the proposals.
n3940dcdadf.why: Road-user charges would change the running costs of electric vehicles, affecting demand for EVs and related automotive investment.

nc9f11f95c2.headline: Delta, REA sign MoU to tackle blackout
nc9f11f95c2.summary: Delta State Government has moved to tackle its power deficit, where more than 60 per cent of communities remain unconnected to the national grid. It signed an MoU with the Rural Electrification Agency.
nc9f11f95c2.why: Reliable power is a basic input for industry and commerce, and grid access gaps constrain economic growth in Nigeria's regions. The Rural Electrification Agency runs federal programmes that extend power to unserved areas.

nd5826fd499.headline: Chancellor will have to raise taxes despite lower borrowing, say economists
nd5826fd499.summary: UK state borrowing slowed to £1.1 billion in July, providing some relief for the Chancellor. Economists say taxes will still have to rise despite the lower borrowing.
nd5826fd499.why: Government borrowing and fiscal policy shape gilt yields, the UK budget outlook and the tax burden on businesses and households.

n7c35c36dd3.headline: Pakistan is tapping into solar power at an 'unprecedented' rate. Here's why
n7c35c36dd3.summary: Solar experts say there has never been faster adoption of solar power in Pakistan, with panels appearing on rooftops across the country. The trend is described as unprecedented.
n7c35c36dd3.why: Rapid solar uptake reduces household and industrial reliance on grid electricity and imported fuel, affecting energy demand and trade.

nfe5076427d.headline: Israel will call up 60,000 reservists. And, N.C. braces for effects of Hurricane Erin
nfe5076427d.summary: Israel plans to call up 60,000 reservists for its new Gaza City offensive, according to the report. The mobilisation is a major labour and military step.
nfe5076427d.why: Large reservist call-ups draw workers out of the civilian economy and can weigh on Israeli output and sentiment during conflict.

source.name: NPR Las Vegas | Nevada Public Radio (KNPR 88.9)

sources.name: NPR Las Vegas | Nevada Public Radio (KNPR 88.9)

n766d6124b4.headline: Housing Authority stuck with $5.8m in bad debts
n766d6124b4.summary: The Fiji Housing Authority remains exposed to $5.8 million in bad debts. The remaining provision includes $1 million in general provisions and more than $1 million in other specific provisions.
n766d6124b4.why: State housing agencies carry loan and rental receivables, so unpaid debts affect their finances and the public funds that support them. Provisioning shows how much of that exposure is expected to be lost.

n7426853c5b.headline: FG projects $200bn revenue from Lekki Port in 45 years
n7426853c5b.summary: The Federal Government projects that Lekki Port will generate approximately $200 billion in revenue over the next 45 years. The projection was made by government officials.
n7426853c5b.why: Deep-sea ports handle container trade and generate port fees and logistics revenue. Long-term revenue projections help assess the return on large infrastructure investments.

n1dcde620ab.headline: FIRS, Customs, NUPRC withhold N658bn as revenue collection...
n1dcde620ab.summary: The FIRS, Customs and NUPRC withheld N657.99 billion as the cost of revenue collection in the first six months of 2025, according to Daily Trust.
n1dcde620ab.why: Federal revenue agencies collect taxes and oil revenues that fund government spending, so the amount retained for collection costs affects the net revenue available to government.

n5f7faba0f2.headline: 12.2% Total Return In H1 2025! Global Equity Income Trust GOT Delivers
n5f7faba0f2.summary: Global Opportunities Trust reported a 4.0% NAV total return and a 12.2% share price total return for the six months to June 30, 2025. Net assets rose to £110.7 million.
n5f7faba0f2.why: Investment trusts are closed-end funds listed on the London Stock Exchange, and their NAV and share price performance guides investors in the sector.

nc0cbd9a8a1.headline: Taraba farmers not smiling despite bumper harvests
nc0cbd9a8a1.summary: As the harvest season begins in Taraba State, Nigeria, food crop prices have fallen to historic lows in recent years. Many farmers are in a precarious position despite bumper harvests.
nc0cbd9a8a1.why: Crop prices shape farm incomes and food inflation in Nigeria, where agriculture is a large share of employment.

n46f178d25d.headline: Jaiz bank’s total assets hit N1.08 trn
n46f178d25d.summary: Jaiz Bank, a non-interest financial institution, said its total assets expanded 86% to ₦1.08 trillion. The bank is one of Nigeria's largest Islamic-banking institutions.
n46f178d25d.why: Jaiz Bank is a Nigerian non-interest (Islamic) lender, and its asset growth reflects demand for Sharia-compliant banking in Nigeria.

nf87e984a1c.headline: Reps summon 11 Discos over N2.6trn debt to FG
nf87e984a1c.summary: Nigeria's House of Representatives Public Accounts Committee has summoned 11 electricity distribution companies over an outstanding debt of N2.6 trillion owed to the federal government.
nf87e984a1c.why: Electricity distribution companies in Nigeria buy power and collect tariffs from consumers, so their debts to the state affect the power sector's finances and government revenue.

n951ac43417.headline: WHSmith Cuts Profit Outlook After £30m Overstatement In North America
n951ac43417.summary: WHSmith has cut its full-year headline profit before tax to around £110 million after finding a £30 million overstatement of trading profit in North America, linked to early supplier income recognition.
n951ac43417.why: WHSmith is a UK high-street retailer with travel and high-street operations in the UK and North America, and profit warnings often weigh on its share price.
n951ac43417.why_moved: The company cut its full-year profit guidance after overstating trading profit in its North America division, reducing its forecast for that division from £55 million to £25 million.

n350b66c3cd.headline: UK government borrowing less than expected in July
n350b66c3cd.summary: UK government borrowing slowed to £1.1 billion in July, lower than expected. The figure gives Chancellor Rachel Reeves some relief before the autumn budget.
n350b66c3cd.why: Public borrowing data feeds into fiscal forecasts and gilt market pricing, and it shapes the scope for tax and spending decisions at the budget.

n864fb39e52.headline: Revenues at architects Henry J Lyons stabilise at €30m
n864fb39e52.summary: Revenues at Irish architectural practice Henry J Lyons stabilised at €30 million. Directors shared €2.93 million in remuneration last year.
n864fb39e52.why: Henry J Lyons is one of Ireland's largest architectural practices, and its results indicate conditions in the Irish construction and design market.

nd394d0ef94.headline: Sui Foundation Allocates to XAUm as Tokenized Gold Goes Live on Sui Network
nd394d0ef94.summary: Matrixdock deployed its tokenised gold token XAUm on the Sui network. The Sui Foundation allocated funds to the token.
nd394d0ef94.why: Tokenised gold represents physical gold on blockchain networks, linking commodity prices with crypto markets. Sui is a layer-1 blockchain network.

nb0c3b8ebbe.headline: Marzetti :  Reports Fourth Quarter Sales and Earnings
nb0c3b8ebbe.summary: The Marzetti Company, trading on Nasdaq, reported fourth-quarter and fiscal year sales and earnings on August 21, 2025. Full figures were not included in the input.
nb0c3b8ebbe.why: Marzetti is an Ohio-based food company known for dressings and dips, and its results indicate demand and margins in packaged foods.

n0a01c2473a.headline: 'Holy grail': treasurer hails quick wins as summit ends
n0a01c2473a.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers' economic roundtable ended after 29 hours and 327 contributions. The treasurer described the outcome as a slew of quick wins.
n0a01c2473a.why: The Australian Treasury sets fiscal and economic policy, and roundtable outcomes can shape future government economic measures.

n0fed9f9c15.headline: India snaps up steeply discounted palm oil from Colombia and Guatemala
n0fed9f9c15.summary: Indian buyers purchased palm oil from Colombia and Guatemala for the first time, attracted by steep discounts and landed costs below Southeast Asian supply. Indonesia and Malaysia are usual suppliers.
n0fed9f9c15.why: India is one of the world's largest edible oil importers, so shifts in its sourcing affect global palm oil prices and trade flows between producers.

ne2f1366655.headline: Irish Life becomes latest health insurer to announce
ne2f1366655.summary: Irish Life is the latest health insurer to announce price increases, with plans rising in October. Customers could pay between €25 and €70 more.
ne2f1366655.why: Irish Life is a major Irish life and health insurer, and premium changes shape household costs and insurer revenues in Ireland.

n9d21e8aba0.headline: China and Pakistan foreign ministers agree to launch new economic corridor projects
n9d21e8aba0.summary: Pakistan and China pledged to expand economic cooperation and investment under the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor. The program is a flagship of China's Belt and Road Initiative.
n9d21e8aba0.why: The China-Pakistan Economic Corridor is a major infrastructure and investment program linking the two countries, with implications for energy and trade routes.

n23c0ffc802.headline: Federal union launches campaign denouncing cuts at CRA call centres
n23c0ffc802.summary: The federal union representing Canada Revenue Agency workers has launched an online campaign denouncing staffing cuts. The cuts affect call centre operations.
n23c0ffc802.why: The Canada Revenue Agency administers federal tax collection, and staffing decisions affect public service costs and service delivery.

nca6b09ed33.headline: Saskatchewan premier calls on Prime Minister Carney to meet with China's Xi on canola
nca6b09ed33.summary: Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe called for Prime Minister Mark Carney to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping to resolve trade issues. The issues have led to steep tariffs on Canadian canola products.
nca6b09ed33.why: China is a major buyer of Canadian canola, and tariffs on the product hurt Prairie farm incomes and exporters.

nedec54661c.headline: Sweden picks mini-reactors for first nuclear expansion in 50 years
nedec54661c.summary: Sweden has picked next-generation mini-reactors for its first nuclear expansion in 50 years, with three or five units to be built in southwestern Sweden.
nedec54661c.why: Nuclear expansion creates long-term demand for reactor technology suppliers and shapes Sweden's electricity supply and energy prices.

n92c50b692d.headline: Gold breaks losing-streak as per tola price up by Rs2,000
n92c50b692d.summary: Gold prices rose on Thursday in both international and local markets, after declines in the previous two sessions. The tola price in Karachi was up by Rs2,000.
n92c50b692d.why: Gold is a widely held store of value, and Pakistani local prices reflect both international bullion moves and the rupee exchange rate. Gold prices affect household savings and import costs.

n21c1f6d6bc.headline: One of Honda's joint-venture partners in China is getting ready to bail
n21c1f6d6bc.summary: Dongfeng, one of Honda's joint-venture partners in China, has put its 50% share of their engine company up for sale. The description is truncated.
n21c1f6d6bc.why: Honda's China joint ventures are a major part of its sales and production footprint, so changes in ownership affect its exposure to the Chinese auto market.

n984e5a0325.headline: SM to unveil Pasay 360 master plan
n984e5a0325.summary: SM Prime Holdings plans to unveil this year the master plan for its ongoing reclamation project in Pasay, the company said.
n984e5a0325.why: SM Prime is a listed Philippine property developer within the SM Group, with large mixed-use projects that drive its real estate revenues.

n2b861abd79.headline: Philippines retains credit mark
n2b861abd79.summary: Rating and Investment Information affirmed the Philippines' investment-grade rating at A- with a stable outlook, citing robust growth, manageable external risks and fiscal consolidation.
n2b861abd79.why: Sovereign credit ratings influence the borrowing costs a government faces and the investment decisions of institutions that must hold investment-grade debt.

nf6aa902c3f.headline: Canadian crossings into NY continued to drop in July
nf6aa902c3f.summary: Canadian crossings into New York State kept dropping in July, according to tracking by Senator Chuck Schumer's office. The decline follows US tariffs imposed by the Trump administration.
nf6aa902c3f.why: Cross-border travel and shopping by Canadians support tourism and retail in border states. Tariff-driven declines hit those local sectors.

n59db0505a7.headline: Tariffs: Quebec liquor board prepares to destroy $300,000 worth of American alcohol
n59db0505a7.summary: The Quebec liquor board may be forced to destroy $300,000 worth of American alcohol that the province has banned from stores amid tariffs.
n59db0505a7.why: Retaliatory trade measures between Canada and the United States affect provincial retail sales and cross-border supply of goods.

nf9b5646f36.headline: How much government interest debt could cost Canadians this year | National
nf9b5646f36.summary: A new study estimates that the Government of Canada's interest debt will cost each Canadian thousands of dollars this year.
nf9b5646f36.why: Federal interest payments on public debt absorb a growing share of the budget and influence fiscal policy and bond issuance.

ne20721479f.headline: Rising concerns over U.S. move to broaden products subject to metal tariffs
ne20721479f.summary: There is growing concern over a U.S. move to make hundreds more product categories subject to its 50 per cent tariffs on steel and aluminum content.
ne20721479f.why: Tariffs on steel and aluminum raise input costs for manufacturers across many downstream industries.

nd4497d3fbb.headline: 2.4K Ontario real estate agents out of work after agency ordered to close: RECO  | Globalnews.ca
nd4497d3fbb.summary: About 2,400 Ontario real estate agents must find a new brokerage after a well-known agency was ordered to close by the regulator RECO.
nd4497d3fbb.why: The Real Estate Council of Ontario regulates brokerages and agents, and regulatory closures affect housing-market services.
